arguments.sql: SELECT 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id WHERE ml.state = 'Italy'
arguments.explanation: Computes the fraud rate over labelled transactions whose merchant location is in Italy.
assumptions: Italy is identified by merchant_locations.state = 'Italy', since the state column holds country names outside the US.
Only labelled transactions are counted; unlabelled ones are excluded rather than treated as legitimate.
